subject: Mediform KMS/HSM + Residency pricing discussion
messages:
From: Alice Tan <alice.tan@mediform.com>
To: hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@mediform.com
Date: 2027-07-21T17:24:00-07:00
Subject: KMS/HSM + residency pricing — initial ask

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for taking the time last week. Procurement asked me to collect a clearer picture of how Redwood prices the security add-ons so we can compare apples-to-apples across vendors. Our primary asks:

- KMS usage pricing (per-encrypt/decrypt or per-key ops) and any volume bands.
- HSM seat pricing (dedicated HSMs or managed hardware) and how you amortize implementation vs recurring.
- Data residency: we need EU-first residency for PHI, with fallback to US for DR. Any surcharge for EU residency?
- Audit log retention: tiered retention (90/365/1095 days) and per-GB pricing.

Rough expected volumes for sizing: ~5M generated tokens/month (text gen), ~10k encryption ops/day, and initial pilot for EU region only. Term: we're targeting a 24–36 month committed deployment, but procurement prefers amortize implementation fees over 12 months.

I've attached our SOC2 attestation and an excerpt from our procurement packet to give context. Could you share a few packaging options (seat-first, usage-first, and a blended path) and any pilot/first-year concessions you can offer? Also include lead time for HSM provisioning and whether you require minimum seat counts.

Thanks — look forward to a proposal we can take to legal/procurement.

— Alice
Alice Tan
Head of Procurement, Mediform Health
[Attachment: SOC2_report_Q2_2027.pdf (pdf)]

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Tan <alice.tan@mediform.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-07-22T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: KMS/HSM + residency pricing — initial ask

Hi Alice — thanks, and appreciated the details. Quick responses inline and then a suggested set of packaging options below.

Summary answers:
- KMS: we can price per-encrypt (recommended for small volumes) or as a flat per-key + per-op blend for predictable throughput. Volume bands at 0-50k ops/day, 50k-250k ops/day, 250k+ with step discounts.
- HSM: two models — seat-based managed HSM (monthly seat + setup) or HSM-as-a-service with a larger upfront procurement but lower monthly. We can amortize setup over 12 months by default.
- Residency: EU residency is available; we apply a regional surcharge (list below) for dedicated EU clusters. Drop-in failover to US DR available with no data egress charge for active failover window <= 72 hrs.
- Audit logs: tiered retention with per-GB pricing; can also offer fixed retention bundles if you prefer a predictable bill.

Packaging options (proposal):
1) Seat-first (HSM-heavy)
- HSM seat x3 (minimum seats for HA), setup fee amortized over 12 months, monthly seat fee. KMS billed per-op.
- Audit logs: 365 day tier included; extended 1095 at extra per-GB.
- EU surcharge: +18% on infra line item.

2) Usage-first
- No HSM seats up-front; HSM fallback via RedVault (shared HSM) with higher per-op KMS pricing. Good for pilots; scales with usage.

3) Blended (recommended)
- 40% seat + 60% usage split for billing economics. Setup amortized over 12 months; first 3 months pilot discount (50% on infra).
- Offer a 15% credit on HSM seats for a 24-month minimum commit.

Attachments: pricing_matrix_v1.xlsx (simple banding + example invoice), draft_amendment_v1.docx (amendment template).

Questions for you: can you confirm whether procurement needs invoice deferral (net 30/60), and whether HIPAA BAAs are required (I assume yes for PHI). Once you confirm volumes and legal asks we can draft a DocuSign amendment.

Talk soon,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: pricing_matrix_v1.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Alice Tan <alice.tan@mediform.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@mediform.com
Date: 2027-07-22T11:13:00-07:00
Subject: Re: KMS/HSM + residency pricing — initial ask

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for the clear layout — that helps. A few clarifications from procurement and engineering:
- Target sustained gen tokens: 5M/month (may jump to 8–9M in year 2).
- Encryption ops: 10k/day steady-state, with spikes up to 40k/day during peak batch jobs (weekly).
- Residency: primary EU (Ireland region) for PHI. US for DR only. HIPAA is required; we will need a signed BAA and evidence of encryption-at-rest for backups.
- Invoice terms: procurement prefers net 60 for new vendors, but we can accommodate net 30 if Redwood offers a 5% early-pay credit.
- Implementation amortization: procurement will push for 12-month amortization if possible.

We attached our procurement_requirements.pdf — it includes timelines (pilot in Q4 2027) and board approval cadence. If you can consolidate a blended financials example that amortizes setup over 12 months and shows first year cashflow with and without a 15% seat credit, that will help our committee.

— Alice
[Attachment: procurement_requirements.pdf (pdf)]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-07-22T13:44:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mediform KMS/HSM pricing — internal recomendation

Quick internal note — recommended concession buckets for Mediform:

1) Pilot concession: 3 months 50% infra discount (keeps unit economics but lowers procurement friction).
2) Seat credit: 15% off HSM seats for a 24-month commit. Avoid deeper up-front credits to protect seat economics.
3) Invoice terms: offer net 60 with 3% early-pay (within 15 days) or net 30 with 5% early-pay credit (mirrors Alice's ask).
4) EU surcharge: we can be flexible between +15–20% depending on capacity reservations; prefer +18% in initial quote.

Also propose including a 90-day audit log retention tier in the base with optional 365/1095 add-ons — procurement rarely pays per-GB surprises.

Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Strategic Deals — Redwood Inference

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Tan <alice.tan@mediform.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-07-23T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: KMS/HSM + residency pricing — consolidated proposal

Hi Alice — based on your inputs and internal alignment, here's a consolidated blended proposal you can share with procurement/finance. I'll put this into a DocuSign amendment once you confirm the model.

Blended proposal (example economics for Year 1):
- Model: 40% HSM-seat + 60% KMS-usage.
- HSM seats: 3 seats (HA), monthly seat fee $6,000/seat. Setup fee $30,000 amortized over 12 months.
- KMS ops: $0.00018 per encrypt op (volume bands applied after 250k/day).
- EU residency surcharge: +18% on infra lines.
- Audit logs: 90-day retention included; 365-day add-on $0.02/GB/month; 1095-day available by request.
- Pilot concession: first 3 months 50% infra discount.
- Seat credit: 15% off seats for 24-month commit.
- Invoice terms: standard net 30. We can offer net 60 with a 3% early-pay reduction applied to the first-year invoice schedule, or net 30 with a 5% early-pay (within 15 days) credit if that helps speed approval.

Next steps:
1) Confirm final expected volumes (you already gave the baseline; confirm any Q2->Q3 growth assumptions).
2) I will upload a DocuSign amendment with the blended pricing and the BAA attached.
3) Procurement signs, we schedule HSM provisioning (lead time ~6–8 weeks for EU dedicated seats).

DocuSign draft: https://www.docusign.com/embdoc?docId=ABC123-draft-amendment
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DEAL-2027-0419

If procurement wants a cashflow view showing amortization vs up-front, I can attach an invoice example (xlsx).

Best,
Hannah
[Attachment: draft_amendment_v1.docx (docx), pricing_matrix_v1.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Alice Tan <alice.tan@mediform.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@mediform.com
Date: 2027-07-23T14:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: KMS/HSM + residency pricing — consolidated proposal

Hi Hannah — this looks good and very actionable. Procurement will review the blended numbers and the cashflow example; two quick asks before we can move to legal:

1) Can Redwood push HSM lead time to 5 weeks instead of 6–8 (we have a tight pilot cadence)?
2) Would Redwood consider deferring the first invoice for 30 days post-go-live (not purely invoice terms) to align with our board schedule?

If you can confirm those two items we should be able to route to legal and get a draft PO within two weeks.

Thanks for the quick turnaround — copying procurement to keep review in-thread.

— Alice
